their carrying amounts, which would require a further interim impairment analysis.&#160;However, unfavorable economic conditions, including tariffs and continued cost inflation, could impact the Company's future projected cash flows and discount rates used to estimate fair value, which could result in an impairment charge to any of the Company's reporting units in a future period.</span></div><span></span>
